application_version.schema_rule: derived: the number of files in infrastructure/migrations (impact_api/version.py)

authority: Original backlog and task cores preserved. Additive execution/verification recommendations use the attached bundle; no owner/engineer approval, checker PASS, Ready/Done, sprint selection or run claimed.
native_update_policy: Append reconciliation only after live issue readback; root/native writer owns publication. Preserve human edits, status, estimates, assignees, parents, milestones and every existing dependency. This file is not a bulk status update.

bundle_source.identity_note: Shipped identity from bundle entry, not a new trust-store approval or checker pass.

current_authority.applies: A task touches a tenant API or protected information boundary.
current_authority.required: Resolve server identity and current scoped grants before access and again at the source-defined replay/job/disclosure boundary. Tenant/object selectors do not prove authority. Preserve non-disclosing hidden/missing RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE behavior.
current_authority.evidence: Separate synthetic tenants and permitted, wrong-scope, revoked and missing selectors; inspect response and durable effects, not only hidden controls.

atomic_mutation.applies: A tenant command changes a governed object or records an external intent.
atomic_mutation.required: Take the tenant write lock before resolving authority; use closed DTOs and expected revisions. Preserve one atomic head/revision/projection/audit/outbox-intent/receipt transition and immutable prior history. Exact retries reuse the original operation ID and bytes; semantic conflicts are not retried automatically.
atomic_mutation.evidence: Pin before/after revisions, audit, receipts and intent counts for success, stale revision and exact replay; native independent sessions are needed for concurrency claims.

native_boundary.applies: The original plan assigns native verification or the task changes forced RLS, login roles, concurrency or durable recovery.
native_boundary.required: Keep the original native level. Use the provisioned non-owner roles, concurrent sessions/restart or restore as applicable; fresh PGlite cannot establish native RLS, contention or recovery.
native_boundary.evidence: Actual native configuration/roles, exact source and test-node identities, complete output including failures/skips, before/after durable-state checks.

plain_accessible_ui.applies: A task changes a browser surface.
plain_accessible_ui.required: Show permitted information only; keep loading, denial, failure and recovery states distinct. Verify keyboard/focus/status behavior and the applicable WCAG 2.2 AA source criteria. Preserve uncertain operation identity until resolved.
plain_accessible_ui.evidence: Named synthetic screen journey with actual DOM/focus/announcement observations and server refusal; automation is not a substitute for the source-required manual assistive-technology review.

deterministic_numbers.applies: A task changes calculations, numeric comparisons or numeric provenance.
deterministic_numbers.required: Keep decimal strings, source-owned units/versions and deterministic governed rules. Preserve NUMERIC(38,12), 50-digit intermediate arithmetic and one final half-up rounding where this platform calculation contract applies; zero denominator remains UNDEFINED. Hypothetical value-case numbers do not become official outcomes.
deterministic_numbers.evidence: Independent source-derived numeric oracle, missingness/zero denominator/rounding examples and unchanged locked-result provenance; no invented benefits, prices or conversion rates.

independent_decision.applies: The source names independent review or self-approval restrictions, rather than an ordinary preference or draft edit.
independent_decision.reference: AGENTS.md; source Gherkin for the linked story
independent_decision.required: Preserve distinct natural-person author and authorised decision maker. Multiple accounts/aliases or agent reviews do not provide independence. Re-fetch the exact candidate before decision.
independent_decision.evidence: Same-person/alias refusal and genuinely independent synthetic-principal positive case, with pinned candidate/revision and no side effects from a refusal.

ai_assurance.applies: The source capability produces or consumes AI-generated suggestions, recommendations, predictions, ranks or actions.
ai_assurance.reference: product-management-agent-bundle-v4.2/AI-ASSURANCE.md AI-01 through AI-07; source AI policy story
ai_assurance.required: Reuse one scoped current assurance record; record the affected AI-01..07 groups, intended use and prohibited effects, permitted/synthetic evaluation data, pinned configuration and held-out/critical-slice plan, uncertainty/refusal/fallback, data-flow rights, regression/rollback and monitoring. Unknown applicability or thresholds remain needs_input. AI proposals cannot overwrite official facts or acquire authority.
ai_assurance.evidence: Proposed source/dataset/rubric/configuration manifests and per-slice evaluation/refusal/rollback results. Deterministic synthetic adapters are not live-provider quality evidence. No provider request or paid execution is authorised here.

external_effect.applies: A task affects jobs, notifications, exports delivered to recipients or an external/provider operation.
external_effect.required: Write intent in the governed transaction; execute external effects outside it under current authority and source-defined fenced leases. Queued intent is not delivered output, provider response or settled charge. Preserve unknown outcomes for reconciliation.
external_effect.evidence: Actual consumer/delivery receipt or synthetic sink observation, generation fencing and retry/no-double-effect evidence; provider and cloud activation remain separate gates.

source_nfr.applies: The story is an NFR or has a source quantitative acceptance condition.
source_nfr.reference: Original requirement, original acceptance and exact Gherkin in docs/backlog/backlog.csv
source_nfr.required: Retain every original threshold, workload, environment/device and failure rule. Keep component-local measurements separate from full source acceptance. No arbitrary new threshold, percentile, capacity or retry budget is agreed by this proposal.
source_nfr.evidence: Versioned workload/fixture, actual complete distribution/errors/outliers, environment and source threshold comparison; missing physical/production/manual evidence stays pending.

bounded_result.title: Make cancellation and every terminal outcome settle once
bounded_result.type: Specific interaction/state or integration artifact and user-visible evidence
bounded_result.specific_contribution: Implement a settlement-aware cancel command and shared terminal transition for success, failure, cancellation and authority/policy loss. Before provider acceptance, release the unused reservation; after acceptance, record observed or conservatively bounded uncertain consumption and release only the unused portion. Commit terminal state, journal settlement, audit/outbox and relevant receipt atomically under the tenant lock and lease fence. Explicitly isolate or delegate the generic worker cancellation pass so it cannot mark an AI job Cancelled without accounting; later provider reconciliation appends an adjustment rather than another terminal settlement.
source_task_acceptance_criteria: Queued cancellation creates no provider call and one terminal release; running cancellation stops the next controllable call while separately accounting for already accepted/uncertain work.
Native cancel-versus-complete-versus-takeover races create exactly one terminal settlement and never a negative/double-released balance or stale result.
Retries, authority loss after accepted work and executor restart cannot strand or erase a reservation; conservative uncertain accounting is visible until reconciled by a new adjustment.
The worker's existing non-AI cancellation tests retain their established behaviour, and every AI terminal transition is settlement-aware without broadening worker tenant-data access.

bounded_result.title: Integrate authorised baseline history and correction references
bounded_result.type: Specific interaction/state or integration artifact and user-visible evidence
bounded_result.specific_contribution: Implement bounded baseline/lock history under current read authority and the reviewed correction model. If a correction is allowed, create a new separately identified successor with a reason and explicit superseded lock reference; never unlock, repoint or rewrite the earlier baseline. If correction is deferred, expose that limit and reject unsupported correction commands. Retain the link to the original problem even after a later diagnosis revision, while hiding any evidence whose current access or restriction has changed.
source_task_acceptance_criteria: History shows the exact earlier locked problem/metric revision and date using principal/route/visibility-bound signed cursors, without total_rows leakage.
Allowed successor corrections preserve the original lock byte-for-byte and explicitly name its predecessor/reason; otherwise correction commands fail under the agreed deferred-scope rule.
A later diagnosis edit cannot silently attach the old baseline to a different problem or replace its source observation basis.
Read and history recheck current tenant/object/evidence authority; restricted, hidden or other-tenant selectors do not disclose original titles or content.

bounded_result.type: Bounded service or storage change and reproducible behavioral evidence

bounded_result.title: Create idempotent threshold notices with delivery proof
bounded_result.type: Bounded service or storage change and reproducible behavioral evidence
bounded_result.specific_contribution: Implement threshold transitions keyed by tenant, budget window, threshold and authorised recipient, computed atomically from the agreed journal exposure basis. Create the notification revision/audit and IN_APP_NOTICE outbox intent in the same transition transaction; reuse delivery.py and the worker's consumer/notification_delivery discipline for visible delivered notices. A jump crosses both keys, release/re-entry does not duplicate a prior alert in that window, and a new window has new keys. Recheck recipient authority at delivery and handle no eligible recipient or delivery failure as a recorded unresolved alert state, not a successful receipt.
source_task_acceptance_criteria: Exact synthetic crossings at 80 percent and 100 percent create one notice per window/threshold/recipient; a direct jump creates both notices and restart/replay creates no duplicates.
A reservation release then recross in the same window does not re-alert the same threshold; a new budget window can alert independently.
Delivered notifications visible to the eligible Operations Head have notification_delivery/consumer receipt evidence; an outbox intent alone cannot pass the source rejection criterion.

Revoked/inactive recipients are not sent protected usage details; failed/pending delivery and no-recipient outcomes remain visible as unresolved evidence without widening worker privileges unnecessarily.

bounded_result.type: Reviewable contract/decision artifact
bounded_result.specific_contribution: Specify stable local draft/submission IDs, attachment manifests, atomic-save recovery markers and device receipt states distinct from server receipts. Declare the qualified secure-storage profile and unsafe-storage refusal.
source_task_acceptance_criteria: The durable local draft/attachment receipt schema artifact has reviewable fixtures covering: a device receipt and safe status are shown; drafts, stable IDs and attachment references persist; the saved answers survive and recovered work is listed.
Its scenario oracle also confirms: the incomplete file is flagged; no false server received status appears; a storage warning appears before capture becomes unsafe.

inputs.purpose: Preserve Durable local capture original behavior, rejection and measurable boundaries.
Resolve these exact existing anchors before editing; listed paths and hashes do not certify that the proposed behavior is implemented.

inputs.source_requirement: Every local save returns a device receipt and safe status. The client persists drafts, stable IDs and attachment references within the qualified device profile.
